## R Markdown

#step 1 Get Tools

#Load packages to help with data and visualisation

library(tidyverse) library(gt)

#step 2 Load Dataset

#Download the file from GitHub

url
\<-"<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chingiz1492/trucks/main/trucks.csv>"
trucks \<- read_csv(url)

#Show the first 5 lines in a table

trucks %\>% head(5) %\>% gt() %\>% tab_header(title = "First 5 Rows of
Data")

#step 3 Change Data

# Create a new group called 'era' based on 'model_year'

# If year is before 2010 -\> Classic. If 2010 or later -\> Modern.

trucks_analysis \<- trucks %\>% mutate(era = if_else(model_year \< 2010,
"Classic", "Modern")) %\>% filter(!is.na(model_year)) \# Delete rows
with empty years

#step 4: Make a Graphic

# Draw a bar chart using our new 'era' groups

ggplot(trucks_analysis, aes(x = model_year, fill = era)) + geom_bar() +
theme_minimal() + labs( title = "Trucks by Year", x = "Year", y =
"Count", fill = "Group" )

# --- STEP 5: Checking

# Print a message to show everything is done

print("Success! Dataset is ready.")
